## Local verification complete; two unrelated pre-existing failures dispositioned

Full unit suite on this branch: **8298 passed**, 26 skipped, 2 failed, 7 errors. Every non-pass is
accounted for and none belong to this change:

**The 7 errors were my own concurrency artifact, not defects.** Each read
`Failed: Test moved the repo HEAD (acf74d7ceb -> d92705df3a)` — I committed while the suite was
still running, and the harness guard correctly objected. Re-running all seven files plus the new
guard against a stable HEAD: **117 passed, 0 failed.** Worth noting as a trap for other agents:
committing mid-suite produces seven scary-looking errors that are pure timing.

**The 2 failures are pre-existing external-tool tests, one already owned.**
- `tests/unit/metrics/test_scc_loc_heldout.py::test_live` — `KeyError: 'sample.py'`. This is
  [rebar:c5b3-1b8a-08dd-40af] (in_progress, another agent): `scc_loc.analyze` omits `--by-file`,
  so scc returns per-language summaries with an EMPTY `Files` key. Not filed again.
- `tests/unit/metrics/test_jscpd_dup_heldout.py::test_live_clone` — `assert 0 >= 1`, the jscpd
  live-tool sibling of the same family.

I also hit `tests/unit/grounding/test_coverage_reconstruction.py::test_full_backend_account_is_present`
failing (`'metric'` absent from the backend account table). I verified it reproduces on a clean
detached worktree at `origin/main`, so it is not mine, and I had drafted a separate bug for it —
then found c5b3 and did NOT file it, because the metric backend is the scc backend and this is very
likely the same root cause surfacing in a third place. Flagging it here so c5b3's owner can confirm
that their fix also restores `metric` to the account table; if it does not, it deserves its own
ticket at that point.

**Gerrit:** change 1430 pushed, awaiting `LLM-Review` and `Verified`. Not closing this ticket —
see the open apply residual in the previous comment.
